## Checklist

- [ ] Base is `main` (legacy stacked PRs: see CONTRIBUTING.md and #171)
- [ ] Scope is focused; reviewed the 400-line PR guideline
- [ ] New logic has tests; authorization/security changes test both denied and allowed paths
- [ ] New files have SPDX headers
- [ ] User-visible changes are in `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased; README/API docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Bilingual documents: Vietnamese and English sections updated together
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or real user data
- [ ] Reviewer is not the author; required co-review (see CONTRIBUTING.md) is requested
